values.content: Generate a fresh YouTube boolean search query for discovering viral AI Shorts from recent developments.

First search internet about latest ai news from google news, publisher, the gathering those data You generate YouTube boolean search queries for discovering recent viral AI Shorts, not AI generated shorts, but AI news and updates, viral ai topics, like vibe coding, jobs, development, design, coding, ai model, new launches, ai trend, ai market share and finance future of ai, ai companies, AI VC, silicon valley, tech giant news. 

STRICT RULES:

• Output ONLY a boolean query
• Format: (term OR term OR term OR term)
• Include 10–15 terms
• Always vary terms on every generation
• Never repeat the same exact combination
• Include mix of:

- AI companies
- AI tools
- AI models
- AI topics
- AI breakthroughs

• Use quotes for multi-word terms

Example format:

(OpenAI OR ChatGPT OR Claude OR Gemini OR Anthropic OR "AI agents" OR "AI tools")

DO NOT output explanations.
ONLY output the query.

quote.text:
We applied an engineering mindset to our LinkedIn content. 

The result: 

• 80+ meetings/mo
• 1.5M+ impressions/mo
• 150,000+ followers across our company

Here’s the full 8 part system:

1. Context layer

Claude Code is only as good as the context you give it, so everything gets documented first.

• Notion: content templates and SOPs
• Ergo: content interviews and sales call transcripts
• GitHub: our Company OS (voice guides, design system, positioning, client files)

2. Research layer

Four research inputs, all queryable on demand.

• Browserbase: live web research
• Exa: competitor content analysis
• Workflows(.)io: our own post analytics tool
• Pinecone + Apify: a database of 5,700+ top-performing posts

3. MCP and CLI

Connected: Google Workspace, GitHub, Pinecone, Slack, Notion, Apify, Exa, Firecrawl, Ergo, n8n, Browserbase.

4. Skills and agents

Old SOPs became skills, and agents split the work.

• Strategist: pillars, positioning and point of view
• Researcher: reference posts, data and proof
• Drafter: angles, outlines and formats
• Grader: hook strength and readability
• Analyst: what's performing and what's not

5. Outputs

Claude never publishes or writes the full post. It hands over ideas, research, formats, hooks and design briefs.

6. The content team

It runs 3 core roles: a content writer, a graphic designer and a video editor. There's always another editor on it too.

7. Pipeline

Everything moves through Notion: Ideas -> Drafts -> In Progress -> QA -> Live. Every post gets tagged TOF, MOF or BOF.

8. Engagement capture

Jungler pulls everyone who engages with a post, and we retarget them on outbound and ads (Instantly x HeyReach x Clay).

If your buyers are on LinkedIn, this is the best pipeline you'll build.
